description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead the clinical team at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA. This is an exceptional opportunity for a visionary nursing leader to make a significant impact on patient care and staff development within a supportive environment.

As the Director of Nursing, you will be responsible for overseeing all nursing operations, ensuring the highest standards of care, and fostering a positive and collaborative work culture. This role offers a competitive annual salary range of $85,000 - $95,000, reflecting your expertise and commitment to excellence. Join a team that values quality, compassion, and professional growth.
requirements: Current Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Iowa
Minimum of 2-3 years of experience in a nursing leadership role, preferably in long-term care or skilled nursing
Strong knowledge of state and federal regulations governing skilled nursing facilities
Demonstrated ability to lead, mentor, and manage a diverse nursing team
Excellent communication, organizational, and interpersonal skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $85,000 - $95,000 based on experience.
